caption:
Card fraud on your account: do you lose the money?

If the fraud wasn't your fault and you report it within 3 working days, your liability is zero.
Report in 4 to 7 working days and you can lose up to ₹10,000 on most savings accounts and cards (₹5,000 on basic accounts, ₹25,000 on some others).
After you report, the bank must credit the disputed amount within 10 working days.
Shared an OTP or PIN? Then the loss until you report is yours.

Have you ever had to dispute a transaction you didn't make?

Sources: the central bank's 2017 circular on limiting customer liability in unauthorised electronic transactions, and a broker's 2026 explainer on the same rules.
